1: 1 How doth the city sit solitary, That was full of people! How is she become as a widow! She that was great among the nations, And princess among the provinces, How is she become tributary! ב <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

She weepeth sore in the night, And her tears are on her cheeks; She hath none to comfort her Among all her lovers; All her friends have dealt treacherously with her, They are become her enemies. ג <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

Judah is gone into exile because of affliction, And because of great servitude; She dwelleth among the nations, She findeth no rest; All her pursuers overtook her Within the straits. ד <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

The ways of Zion do mourn, Because none come to the solemn assembly; All her gates are desolate, Her priests sigh; Her virgins are afflicted, And she herself is in bitterness. ה <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

Her adversaries are become the head, Her enemies are at ease; For the Lord hath afflicted her For the multitude of her transgressions; Her young children are gone into captivity Before the adversary. ו <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

And gone is from the daughter of Zion All her splendour; Her princes are become like harts That find no pasture, And they are gone without strength Before the pursuer. ז <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

Jerusalem remembereth In the days of her affliction and of her anguish All her treasures that she had From the days of old; Now that her people fall by the hand of the adversary, And none doth help her, The adversaries have seen her, They have mocked at her desolations. ח <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

Jerusalem hath grievously sinned, Therefore she is become as one unclean; All that honoured her despise her, Because they have seen her nakedness; She herself also sigheth, And turneth backward. ט <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

Her filthiness was in her skirts, She was not mindful of her end; Therefore is she come down wonderfully, She hath no comforter. 'Behold, O Lord , my affliction, For the enemy hath magnified himself.' י <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

The adversary hath spread out his hand Upon all her treasures; For she hath seen that the heathen Are entered into her sanctuary,  ​ Concerning whom Thou didst command That they should not enter into Thy congregation. כ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
All her people sigh, They seek bread; They have given their pleasant things for food To refresh the soul. 'See, O Lord , and behold, How abject I am become.' ל <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

Let it not come unto you, all ye that pass by! Behold, and see If there be any pain like unto my pain, Which is done unto me, Wherewith the Lord hath afflicted me In the day of His fierce anger. מ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

From on high hath He sent fire Into my bones, and it prevaileth against them; He hath spread a net for my feet, He hath turned me back; He hath made me desolate And faint all the day. נ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

The yoke of my transgressions is impressed by His hand; They are knit together, They are come up upon my neck; He hath made my strength to fail; The Lord hath delivered me into their hands, Against whom I am not able to stand. ס <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

The Lord hath set at nought All my mighty men in the midst of me; He hath called a solemn assembly against me To crush my young men; The Lord hath trodden as in a winepress The virgin daughter of Judah.' ע <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

For these things I weep; Mine eye, mine eye runneth down with water; Because the comforter is far from me, Even he that should refresh my soul; My children are desolate, Because the enemy hath prevailed.' פ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

Zion spreadeth forth her hands; There is none to comfort her; The Lord hath commanded concerning Jacob, That they that are round about him should be his adversaries, Jerusalem is among them As one unclean. צ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

The Lord is righteous; For I have rebelled against His word; Hear, I pray you, all ye peoples, And behold my pain: My virgins and my young men Are gone into captivity. ק <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
I called for my lovers, But they deceived me; My priests and mine elders Perished in the city, While they sought them food To refresh their souls. ר <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

Behold, O Lord , for I am in distress, Mine inwards burn; My heart is turned within me, For I have grievously rebelled. Abroad the sword bereaveth, At home there is the like of death. ש <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

They have heard that I sigh, There is none to comfort me; All mine enemies have heard of my trouble, and are glad, For Thou hast done it; Thou wilt bring the day that Thou hast proclaimed, And they shall be like unto me.  ​ ת <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Let all their wickedness come before Thee; And do unto them, As Thou hast done unto me For all my transgressions; For my sighs are many, And my heart is faint.' א <span class="anchor"
2: 2 How hath the Lord covered with a cloud The daughter of Zion in His anger! He hath cast down from heaven unto the earth The beauty of Israel, And hath not remembered His footstool In the day of His anger. ב <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

The Lord hath swallowed up unsparingly All the habitations of Jacob; He hath thrown down in His wrath The strongholds of the daughter of Judah; He hath brought them down to the ground; He hath profaned the kingdom and the princes thereof. ג <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

He hath cut off in fierce anger All the horn of Israel; He hath drawn back His right hand From before the enemy; And He hath burned in Jacob like a flaming fire, Which devoureth round about. ד <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

He hath bent His bow like an enemy, Standing with His right hand as an adversary, And hath slain all that were pleasant to the eye; In the tent of the daughter of Zion He hath poured out His fury like fire. ה <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

The Lord is become as an enemy, He hath swallowed up Israel; He hath swallowed up all her palaces, He hath destroyed his strongholds; And He hath multiplied in the daughter of Judah Mourning and moaning. ו <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

And He hath stripped His tabernacle, as if it were a garden, He hath destroyed His place of assembly; The Lord hath caused to be forgotten in Zion Appointed season and sabbath, And hath rejected in the indignation of His anger The king and the priest. ז <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

The Lord hath cast off His altar, He hath abhorred His sanctuary, He hath given up into the hand of the enemy The walls of her palaces; They have made a noise in the house of the Lord , As in the day of a solemn assembly. ח <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

The Lord hath purposed to destroy The wall of the daughter of Zion; He hath stretched out the line, He hath not withdrawn His hand from destroying; But He hath made the rampart and wall to mourn, They languish together. ט <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

Her gates are sunk into the ground; He hath destroyed and broken her bars; Her king and her princes are among the nations, Instruction is no more; Yea, her prophets find No vision from the Lord . י <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

They sit upon the ground, and keep silence, The elders of the daughter of Zion; They have cast up dust upon their heads, They have girded themselves with sackcloth; The virgins of Jerusalem hang down Their heads to the ground.   ​ כ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

Mine eyes do fail with tears, Mine inwards burn, My liver is poured upon the earth, For the breach of the daughter of my people; Because the young children and the sucklings swoon In the broad places of the city. ל <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

They say to their mothers: 'Where is corn and wine?' When they swoon as the wounded In the broad places of the city, When their soul is poured out Into their mothers' bosom. מ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

What shall I take to witness for thee? what shall I liken to thee, O daughter of Jerusalem? What shall I equal to thee, that I may comfort thee, O virgin daughter of Zion? For thy breach is great like the sea; Who can heal thee? נ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

Thy prophets have seen visions for thee Of vanity and delusion; And they have not uncovered thine iniquity, To bring back thy captivity; But have prophesied for thee burdens Of vanity and seduction. ס <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

All that pass by clap Their hands at thee; They hiss and wag their head At the daughter of Jerusalem: 'Is this the city that men called The perfection of beauty, The joy of the whole earth?' ע <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

All thine enemies have opened Their mouth wide against thee; They hiss and gnash the teeth; They say: 'We have swallowed her up; Certainly this is the day that we looked for; We have found, we have seen it.' פ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

The Lord hath done that which He devised; He hath performed His word That He commanded in the days of old; He hath thrown down unsparingly; And He hath caused the enemy to rejoice over thee, He hath exalted the horn of thine adversaries. צ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

Their heart cried unto the Lord 'O wall of the daughter of Zion, Let tears run down like a river Day and night; Give thyself no respite; Let not the apple of thine eye cease. ק <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

Arise, cry out in the night, At the beginning of the watches; Pour out thy heart like water Before the face of the Lord; Lift up thy hands toward Him For the life of thy young children, That faint for hunger At the head of every street.' ר <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

See, O Lord , and consider, To whom Thou hast done thus! Shall the women eat their fruit, The children that are dandled in the hands? Shall the priest and the prophet be slain In the sanctuary of the Lord? ש <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

The youth and the old man lie On the ground in the streets; My virgins and my young men Are fallen by the sword; Thou hast slain them in the day of Thine anger; Thou hast slaughtered unsparingly. ת <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

Thou hast called, as in the day of a solemn assembly, My terrors on every side, And there was none in the day of the Lord's anger That escaped or remained;  ​ Those that I have dandled and brought up Hath mine enemy consumed.' א <span class="anchor"
3: 3 I am the man that hath seen affliction By the rod of His wrath. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
He hath led me and caused me to walk In darkness and not in light. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Surely against me He turneth His hand Again and again all the day. ב <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
My flesh and my skin hath He worn out; He hath broken my bones. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
He hath builded against me, and compassed me With gall and travail. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
He hath made me to dwell in dark places, As those that have been long dead. ג <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
He hath hedged me about, that I cannot go forth; He hath made my chain heavy. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Yea, when I cry and call for help, He shutteth out my prayer. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
He hath enclosed my ways with hewn stone, He hath made my paths crooked. ד <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
He is unto me as a bear lying in wait, As a lion in secret places. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
He hath turned aside my ways, and pulled me in pieces; He hath made me desolate. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
He hath bent His bow, and set me As a mark for the arrow. ה <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
He hath caused the arrows of His quiver To enter into my reins. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
I am become a derision to all my people, And their song all the day. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
He hath filled me with bitterness, He hath sated me with wormwood. ו <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
He hath also broken my teeth with gravel stones, He hath made me to wallow in ashes. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
And my soul is removed far off from peace, I forgot prosperity. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
And I said: 'My strength is perished, And mine expectation from the Lord .' ז <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Remember mine affliction and mine anguish, The wormwood and the gall. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
My soul hath them still in remembrance, And is bowed down within me. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
This I recall to my mind, Therefore have I hope. ח <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Surely the Lord's mercies are not consumed, Surely His compassions fail not. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
They are new every morning; Great is Thy faithfulness. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The Lord is my portion', saith my soul; 'Therefore will I hope in Him.' ט <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The Lord is good unto them that wait for Him, To the soul that seeketh Him. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
It is good that a man should quietly wait For the salvation of the Lord . <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
It is good for a man that he bear The yoke in his youth. י <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Let him sit alone and keep silence, Because He hath laid it upon him. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Let him put his mouth in the dust,  ​ If so be there may be hope. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Let him give his cheek to him that smiteth him, Let him be filled full with reproach. כ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For the Lord will not cast off For ever. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For though He cause grief, yet will He have compassion According to the multitude of His mercies. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For He doth not afflict willingly, Nor grieve the children of men. ל <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
To crush under foot All the prisoners of the earth, <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
To turn aside the right of a man Before the face of the Most High, <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
To subvert a man in his cause, The Lord approveth not. מ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Who is he that saith, and it cometh to pass, When the Lord commandeth it not? <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Out of the mouth of the Most High proceedeth not Evil and good? <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Wherefore doth a living man complain, A strong man because of his sins? נ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Let us search and try our ways, And return to the Lord . <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Let us lift up our heart with our hands Unto God in the heavens. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
We have transgressed and have rebelled; Thou hast not pardoned. ס <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Thou hast covered with anger and pursued us; Thou hast slain unsparingly. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Thou hast covered Thyself with a cloud, So that no prayer can pass through. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Thou hast made us as the off-scouring and refuse In the midst of the peoples. פ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
All our enemies have opened their mouth Wide against us. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Terror and the pit are come upon us, Desolation and destruction. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Mine eye runneth down with rivers of water, For the breach of the daughter of my people. ע <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Mine eye is poured out, and ceaseth not, Without any intermission, <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Till the Lord look forth, And behold from heaven. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Mine eye affected my soul, Because of all the daughters of my city. צ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
They have chased me sore like a bird, That are mine enemies without cause. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
They have cut off my life in the dungeon, And have cast stones upon me. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Waters flowed over my head; I said: 'I am cut off.' ק <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
I called upon Thy name, O Lord , Out of the lowest dungeon. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Thou heardest my voice; hide not Thine ear at my sighing, at my cry. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Thou drewest near in the day that I called upon Thee; Thou saidst: 'Fear not.' ר <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Lord, Thou hast pleaded the causes of my soul; Thou hast redeemed my life. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
O Lord , Thou hast been my wrong; Judge Thou my cause.  ​ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Thou hast seen all their vengeance And all their devices against me. ש <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Thou hast heard their taunt, O Lord , And all their devices against me; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The lips of those that rose up against me, And their muttering against me all the day. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Behold Thou their sitting down, and their rising up; I am their song. ת <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Thou wilt render unto them a recompense, O Lord , According to the work of their hands. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Thou wilt give them hardness of heart, Thy curse unto them. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Thou wilt pursue them in anger, and destroy them From under the heavens of the Lord . א <span class="anchor"
4: 4 How is the gold become dim! How is the most fine gold changed! The hallowed stones are poured out At the head of every street. ב <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The precious sons of Zion, Comparable to fine gold, How are they esteemed as earthen pitchers, The work of the hands of the potter! ג <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Even the jackals draw out the breast, They give suck to their young ones; The daughter of my people is become cruel, Like the ostriches in the wilderness. ד <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The tongue of the sucking child cleaveth To the roof of his mouth for thirst; The young children ask bread, And none breaketh it unto them. ה <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
They that did feed on dainties Are desolate in the streets; They that were brought up in scarlet Embrace dunghills. ו <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater Than the sin of Sodom, That was overthrown as in a moment, And no hands fell upon her. ז <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Her princes were purer than snow, They were whiter than milk, They were more ruddy in body than rubies, Their polishing was as of sapphire; ח <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Their visage is blacker than coal; They are not known in the streets; Their skin is shrivelled upon their bones; It is withered, it is become like a stick. ט <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

They that are slain with the sword are better Than they that are slain with hunger; For these pine away, stricken through, For want of the fruits of the field. י <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The hands of women full of compassion Have sodden their own children; They were their food In the destruction of the daughter of my people. כ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The Lord hath accomplished His fury, He hath poured out His fierce anger; And He hath kindled a fire in Zion, Which hath devoured the foundations thereof. ל <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The kings of the earth believed not, Neither all the inhabitants of the world,  ​ That the adversary and the enemy would enter Into the gates of Jerusalem. מ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
It is because of the sins of her prophets, And the iniquities of her priests, That have shed the blood of the just In the midst of her. נ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
They wander as blind men in the streets, They are polluted with blood, So that men cannot Touch their garments. ס <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

Depart ye! unclean!' men cried unto them, 'Depart, depart, touch not'; Yea, they fled away and wandered; Men said among the nations: 'They shall no more sojourn here.' פ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The anger of the Lord hath divided them; He will no more regard them; They respected not the persons of the priests, They were not gracious unto the elders. ע <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
As for us, our eyes do yet fail For our vain help; In our watching we have watched For a nation that could not save. צ <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
They hunt our steps, That we cannot go in our broad places; Our end is near, our days are fulfilled; For our end is come. ק <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Our pursuers were swifter Than the eagles of the heaven; They chased us upon the mountains, They lay in wait for us in the wilderness. ר <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of the Lord , Was taken in their pits; Of whom we said: 'Under his shadow We shall live among the nations.' ש <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

Rejoice and be glad, O daughter of Edom, That dwellest in the land of Uz: The cup shall pass over unto thee also; Thou shalt be drunken, and shalt make thyself naked. ת <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"

The punishment of thine iniquity is accomplished, O daughter of Zion, He will no more carry thee away into captivity; He will punish thine iniquity, O daughter of Edom, He will uncover thy sins. <span class="anchor"
5: 5 Remember, O Lord , what is come upon us; Behold, and see our reproach. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Our inheritance is turned unto strangers, Our houses unto aliens. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
We are become orphans and fatherless, Our mothers are as widows. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
We have drunk our water for money: Our wood cometh to us for price. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
To our very necks we are pursued; We labour, and have no rest. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
We have given the hand to Egypt, And to Assyria, to have bread enough. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Our fathers have sinned, and are not; And we have borne their iniquities. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Servants rule over us; There is none to deliver us out of their hand. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
We get our bread with the peril of our lives Because of the sword of the wilderness. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Our skin is hot like an oven  ​ Because of the burning heat of famine. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
They have ravished the women in Zion, The maidens in the cities of Judah. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Princes are hanged up by their hand; The faces of elders are not honoured. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The young men have borne the mill, And the children have stumbled under the wood. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The elders have ceased from the The young men from their music. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The joy of our heart is ceased; Our dance is turned into mourning. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
The crown is fallen from our head; Woe unto us! for we have sinned. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For this our heart is faint, For these things our eyes are dim; <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
For the mountain of Zion, which is desolate, The foxes walk upon it. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Thou, O Lord , art enthroned for ever, Thy throne is from generation to generation. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Wherefore dost Thou forget us for ever, And forsake us so long time? <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Turn Thou us unto Thee, Lord , and we shall be turned; Renew our days as of old. <span class="wst-verse wst-verse-float"
Thou canst not have utterly rejected us, And be exceeding wroth against us! Turn Thou us unto Thee, O Lord , and we shall be turned; Renew our days as of old.
